title: Climate change: Are there too many people?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Is population size really the main issue in climate change, or is consumption more important?
Is it fair to focus on population growth in poorer countries when wealthier countries often consume more per person?
Should governments ever try to influence how many children people have for environmental reasons?
How can discussions about population avoid blaming particular countries or groups?
What would reduce emissions more effectively: fewer people, lower consumption, or cleaner technology?
